shelfmark: Roma, Archivio della Pontificia Università Gregoriana, APUG 222, p. 5 ('La chiave delle cifre delle lettere di Giansenio scritte all'Abbate di S. Cyrano'); extract of the letters pp. 7-20
note: Key to the cipher of Cornelius Jansen's letters to Duvergier de Hauranne (Saint-Cyran) inside a volume of Jansenist documents (Manus CNMD 0000223292); the letters themselves were edited by Orcibal (Les origines du jansénisme, 1947-48) with the cipher names resolved; ciphertext partner not located here.
